bugs_found: loan_payment uses 1 - monthly_rate instead of 1 + monthly_rate, producing negative or nonsensical payments for positive-rate loans
transfer does not normalize amount to Decimal, so float inputs can raise TypeError or mix precision semantics inconsistently with the other money functions
transfer is not atomic: if crediting account_to.balance fails after debiting account_from.balance, balances are left inconsistent
fx_convert accepts zero or negative FX rates, allowing conversion to zero or negative amounts
years/months/compounds_per_year are coerced with int(), silently truncating fractional inputs instead of rejecting them
